answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 31911 Country: India Title: Plz tell me how to drink the remaining water of ablution when we are doing it in mosque of jug, Question: Plz tell me how to drink the remaining water of ablution when we are doing it in mosque of jug, and you know the jug of mosque is dirty and we can't drink in it, Plz guide me. Answer ID: 31911 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 723/600/B=1432) According to one opinion, it is mustahab to drink the zamzam and the remaining water of wudhu while standing. If the jug is dirty put it in any bowl or glass and drink, otherwise drink it taking in your hand one mouthful water. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
